result: The explicitly specified full-support kernel (-1,-1,-1,4,-1) gives an actual 4x4 PPT ENTANGLED state of Schmidt number exactly 2. A finite decomposition into 761 complex Schmidt-rank<=2 vectors with strictly positive rational weights is supplied and independently checked. This resolves the exact SN of the previously explored one full-support projection; it does NOT solve the original unrestricted 4x4 target.
source_state_and_local_map: Let R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H]), with A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|34>, E=|20>+|33>, F=|23>, G=|30>, I=|32>, H=|04>. Its 4x5 PPT/SN3 state R/31 and source Eq.11 range have exact certificates in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9. Let K|0,1,2>=|0,1,2>, K|3>=(|0>+|1>+|2>+|3>)/4, K|4>=|3>. Set T=(I tensor 4K)R(I tensor 4K)^*. Then rho=T/424 is an actual normalized 4x4 state, and ker K=span{(-1,-1,-1,4,-1)}.

exact_certificate.content: 761 Gaussian-integer coefficient vectors z_j=(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,i,h), 761 strictly positive integer numerators N_j, and a single strictly positive common denominator D. The 9x9 Gram identity sum_j N_j z_j z_j^*=D*diag(1,1,3,1,3,3,3,3,3) is exact. Here M(z)=[[a,b,c,0,h],[d,a,b,0,0],[e,-d,a,f,0],[g,0,i,e,c]], and the corresponding 4x4 vector q_j=M(z_j)(4K)^T.
exact_certificate.physical_decomposition: Each q_j has Schmidt rank <=2; the verifier independently checked ALL sixteen 3x3 minors of EACH of the 761 matrices. It also directly checked every one of the 256 entries of sum_j N_j[q_j]=D*T. Therefore rho=sum_j (N_j/(424D))[q_j] is an exact finite nonnegative complex-SR<=2 decomposition.
exact_certificate.construction: A floating solver selected a well-conditioned positive 761-atom model, but ALL final coefficients were reconstructed by exact integer Bareiss elimination and verified with integer arithmetic. The numerical selection is not the certificate or proof.

Exact Fraction Schur pivots of T^Gamma are [16,16,48,48,32/3,16,3,16,3,48] with the remaining block zero; all are positive. Thus rho is PSD and PPT independently of the numerical selection.

entanglement_proof: Project Alice and Bob onto output labels0,1,2. The unnormalized 3x3 core of R_K=T/16 has range M=[[a,b,c],[d,a,b],[e+f/4,-d+f/4,a+f/4]]. The coefficients a,b,c,d,e,f are uniquely determined. Any rank-one matrix obeys minors a^2-bd=0 and a^2+bd+(a-b)f/4=0, so 2a^2=-(a-b)f/4. For any hypothetical separable core decomposition, positivity puts each product vector in the core range. Taking moduli, summing and applying Cauchy-Schwarz gives 2 sum|a|^2 <= sqrt((1/16)sum|a-b|^2 * sum|f|^2). The independent verifier extracted exact moments sum|a|^2=1, sum|b|^2=1, sum a*conjugate(b)=0 and sum|f|^2=3. Thus separability would require 2<=sqrt(3/8), equivalently 4<=3/8, a contradiction. Local projection cannot create entanglement, so rho is entangled. Together with the exact SR<=2 decomposition, SN(rho)=2.
status_and_limits: The exact verifier checked this single all-five-support kernel state only. Its rank and PPT certificate are not a separator of Schmidt number >=3, and the result does not establish any theorem for every 4x4 PPT state or every local projection. The state is a projection of a previously published 4x5 range; no novelty, external-family/human review, or formal/kernel verification is claimed. The earlier finite rational-chart fitting misses were numerical historical outputs, not no-go theorems.
